context: Goal: you reach the box you want fast when you have many boxes. Problem: the Shelf lists 30 boxes and the folded screen shows about 7, so you scroll; whether to add a jump or a filter is a feature call, yours. Pick any, or None of these to keep scrolling only. Based on: the v3 sample has 30 boxes (read); the folded picture shows boxes 1 to 7 (read); how many boxes you really keep (unmeasured).

designs.label: Shelf v3, folded: boxes 1 to 7 of 30

options.gain: Any box in two taps, nothing new on screen.
options.how: Tapping the Box heading opens a number pad; type a box number to scroll there.
options.label: Tap the Box column to jump

options.gain: Pulling sold cards skips the other boxes.
options.how: A filter chip above the ruler shows only boxes with a sold card to pull.
options.label: A 'boxes with a sale' filter
options.lose: One more control on a full screen; the Orders tab already lists what to pull.

ref: d4 v3 Shelf notes, Checks: 'no way to jump to a box or filter boxes with a sale' (PR #866)
title: Banchi Shelf: which ways to reach a box? Pick any.
why: The jump fixes the reach with no new control; Orders already lists what to pull, so the filter is optional.
